name: media
description: Puts a figure beside a block of text and stacks them when the text would drop below half the width; the one-class form of a sidebar holding a frame and a stack.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Space between the figure and the text.

attributes.name: data-align
attributes.description: Vertical alignment of figure and text when side by side.

attributes.name: data-side
attributes.description: Force the figure to the start or the end regardless of source order. Moves it visually only; reading order stays as written.

children.description: Exactly two: the figure (an img, video, or picture, or an element wrapping one) and the body; the body must not have an img, video, or picture as a direct child (it would be taken for a second figure).

tokens.name: --yeti-space-sm
tokens.description: The gap between the body's children.

a11y.notes: The figure is cropped to its ratio, so alt text should describe what is visible. data-side changes where the figure sits, not where it is read.
